rule.name: NetworkInTest
rule.message: This unit test calls a real remote host, so it fails without the network and depends on that service. Give the subject a fake client, or point it at a local stub: MockWebServer, WireMock or MockRestServiceServer on localhost. A test that needs the real service is an integration test: an IT class, an integration source set or @SpringBootTest.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $loopback := '^(localhost|[^/:@]*\.localhost|127\.[0-9.]+|0\.0\.0\.0|\[::1\]|::1|host\.docker\.internal)$', $hostOf := function($url) { let $authority := tokenize(replace($url, '^[a-zA-Z]+://([^/?#]+).*$', '$1'), '@')[last()] return if (starts-with($authority, '[')) then concat(substring-before($authority, ']'), ']') else tokenize($authority, ':')[1] }, $remoteUrl := function($s) { let $v := lower-case(string($s/@ConstValue)) return matches($v, '^(https?|wss?)://[^/?#]') and not(matches(lower-case($hostOf($v)), $loopback)) }, $remoteHost := function($s) { let $v := string($s/@ConstValue) return matches($v, '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9.-]*$') and not(matches(lower-case($v), $loopback)) }, $initializers := function($n) { let $names := $n/descendant-or-self::*[self::VariableAccess or self::AmbiguousName]/@Name return $n/ancestor::CompilationUnit//VariableDeclarator[VariableId/@Name = $names]/*[last()] }, $literal := function($n) { exists($n/descendant-or-self::StringLiteral[$remoteUrl(.)]) }, $once := function($n) { $literal($n) or (some $i in $initializers($n) satisfies $literal($i)) }, $remote := function($n) { $once($n) or (some $i in $initializers($n) satisfies $once($i)) }, $mockMarks := ('Mock', 'MockBean', 'MockitoBean', 'Spy', 'SpyBean', 'MockitoSpyBean'), $mocked := function($call) { let $name := string($call/*[1]/descendant-or-self::*[self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess or self::AmbiguousName][1]/@Name), $declarators := $call/ancestor::CompilationUnit//VariableDeclarator[VariableId/@Name = $name] return $name != '' and (some $d in $declarators satisfies ($d/../ModifierList/Annotation/@SimpleName = $mockMarks or $d/*[last()][self::MethodCall][@MethodName = ('mock', 'spy')])) }, $unit := function($n) { $n/ancestor::CompilationUnit }, $realJdkClient := function($n) { exists($unit($n)//MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.net.http.HttpClient#newHttpClient()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.net.http.HttpClient#newBuilder()')]) }, $realOkHttp := function($n) { exists($unit($n)//ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('okhttp3.OkHttpClient') or pmd-java:typeIs('okhttp3.OkHttpClient$Builder')]) }, $realApache := function($n) { exists($unit($n)//MethodCall[*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.hc.client5.http.impl.classic.HttpClients') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.http.impl.client.HttpClients') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.hc.client5.http.impl.classic.HttpClientBuilder') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.http.impl.client.HttpClientBuilder')]]) }, $fakeTransport := function($n) { exists($unit($n)//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('exchangeFunction', 'requestFactory', 'clientConnector')]) }, $stubbed := function($call) { exists($call/ancestor::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall [@MethodName = ('when', 'given', 'verify', 'then', 'thenReturn', 'willReturn', 'doReturn')]) } return ( //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('openConnection', 'openStream', 'getContent')][*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.net.URL')]] [$remote(*[1])] | //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.net.http.HttpRequest#newBuilder(java.net.URI)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.net.http.HttpRequest$Builder#uri(java.net.URI)')] [$realJdkClient(.)][$remote(ArgumentList/*[1])] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'url'][*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('okhttp3.Request$Builder')]] [$realOkHttp(.)][$remote(ArgumentList/*[1])] |
